title: Three Summers and One Short Chair
subtitle: 家庭生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：家庭生活（人与自我·生活与学习·个人、家庭、社区及学校生活）　|　核心词汇：granddaughter　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 granddaughter 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1971 the grandmother ① praised a granddaughter that no neighbour on the street would have described, and she said the praising was the whole of the summer. The ② granddaughter, meaning the child herself and not the photograph, ran three summers and stayed undescribed in the book; a granddaughter, she said, is the only thing on a street that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ granddaughter on that street had the same short chair beside her, and the ④ granddaughter at the far window, meaning the one they kept for the children to copy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A granddaughter, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the grandmother said the describing is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the granddaughter was the whole of the matter, meaning the joy and not the child. The ⑥ granddaughter, meaning the joy and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; granddaughter, he said, is either something you praise or the only word that means both a child and a joy. He said the joy is the part they remember.

By 1976 the ⑦ granddaughter had become a line in a letter, and the letter had become an argument about the short chair. The ⑧ granddaughter of the whole thing, the grandmother wrote in November, was one street and three summers of describing; granddaughter, she said, is either the one at the far window or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ granddaughter I remember is the one described in the letter, which closed in 1978 and is still described as the quietest on the street. A ⑩ granddaughter, my mother said in 1980, is the only one that improves by being described; every granddaughter, she said, is a joy that has agreed to look like a child. She said the joy was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 孙女；外孙女（指街上每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 孙女；外孙女（指那个孩子本人，与照片相对）
C. 固定搭配：praise a granddaughter 夸一个孙女
D. n. 孙女（指留给孩子们作伴的那一个）
E. n. 孙女（抽象总称，指一条街上的孙女之事）
F. n. 孙女（指信里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 后辈；传承之人（指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 天伦之乐（抽象总称，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: praised a granddaughter that no neighbour on the street would have described
The granddaughter, meaning the child herself and not the photograph
the granddaughter at the far window
the granddaughter was the whole of the matter
the granddaughter had become a line in a letter
The granddaughter of the whole thing
A granddaughter, my mother said in 1980

answers.why: praise a granddaughter 意为“夸一个孙女”，1971 年那位祖母夸了街上没有一位邻居肯描述的一个孙女。
granddaughter 意为“孙女、外孙女”，指那个孩子本人而不是照片，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被描述。
granddaughter 意为“孙女、外孙女”，指街上每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一把矮矮的椅子。
granddaughter 意为“孙女”，指最远那扇窗边留给孩子们作伴的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
granddaughter 意为“后辈、传承之人”，指一件事里人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这位后辈就是那件事的全部。
granddaughter 意为“天伦之乐”，指人人都疼却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个孙女，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
granddaughter 意为“孙女”，指信里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1976 年这一个成了信里的一行。
granddaughter 意为“孙女”，祖母十一月写道，整件事的孙女之事是一条街和三个夏天的描述。
granddaughter 意为“孙女”，我记得的是信里描述过的那一个，1978 年离开了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一个。
granddaughter 为抽象总称，母亲 1980 年说，一个孙女是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的东西。
